en.dr-ali-peiravi: 6-19 Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated that Sa’ed ibn Abdullah quoted Al-Hassan ibn Musa al-Khishab, on the authority of Qiyath ibn Ibrahim, on the authority of Ishaq ibn Am’mar, on the authority of Aba Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB)

that God’s Prophet (MGB) said, “The Honorable the Exalted God has considered six characteristics to be undesirable for me, my Trustees from amongst my progeny, and their followers: playing while praying; coition when fasting; mentioning acts of charity; going to the mosque in a state of major ritual impurity ; looking into other people’s homes; and laughing in the graveyard.”
